title: 长颈鹿
prompt: The video shows a realistic front-facing autonomous driving scene on a quiet urban street lined with buildings and parked vehicles in daylight. The ego vehicle is stopped or creeping very slowly. Exactly one tall giraffe is already clearly visible close ahead at the beginning and walks steadily from the right toward the left across the near foreground. The animal remains fully visible in the front view throughout the clip, with a recognizable natural body, steady body size, grounded feet, and continuous motion. It stays separate from the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic. The other camera views show their corresponding road surroundings; the same animal appears in another view only if it enters that camera's field of view. The giraffe has a tan coat patterned with large dark brown patches separated by pale lines.
reference_origin: existing training reference pool; not a heldout identity benchmark
projection_scope: direct reference injection is region-gated; cross-view propagation is not strictly forbidden
web_encoding: H264 Main level4.1, CRF24, original resolution/frame count/PTS; source kept locally
quality_status: unfiltered stage observation; appearance and control quality not accepted
